sentences.text: Brandon Stark , typically called Bran , is a fictional character in the A Song of Ice and Fire series of fantasy novels by American author George R. R. Martin , and its television adaptation Game of Thrones .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fictional character	fictional character	fantasy	fantasy

Martin told Rolling Stone in 2014 that Bran 's chapter with Jaime and Cersei Lannister is what `` hooked '' many readers early in the first novel .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	Jaime	Jaime Lannister	Cersei Lannister	Cersei Lannister

Introduced in 1996 's A Game of Thrones , Bran is the son of Ned Stark , the honorable lord of Winterfell , an ancient fortress in the North of the fictional kingdom of Westeros .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	Winterfell	Winterfell	Ned Stark	Ned Stark	the North	the North (A Song of Ice and Fire)	Westeros	Westeros
